what: When the section head reaches the top of the screen, two screens (+=200%) while the section is pinned, the video backdrop behind it turns on (progress 0~5%). The video floats up from .7x and transparent to .94x (4~30%), then grows past the screen to 1.1x (30~50%), blurs 16px (30~52%) and fades to .38 (32~52%). The section text rises over it (50~62%), and the backdrop turns off at the end (90~100%). All of it is tied to scroll with no easing. Use when laying video as a blurred background with text on top in site and team About sections.

options.[data-fx-part=film]: Video curtain (top) — place it inside the section or pick one outside via the film option. The css is position: fixed; inset: 0; laid down at z-index: -1
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video/photo inside the curtain (required) — what scales up and blurs
options.film: CSS to find the curtain outside the section (e.g. #team-film) — a pinned section creates a stacking context, so a z-index: -1 curtain inside it rises above other background layers. For a curtain outside the section, the part sets the position (fixed, inset 0, z-index -1), but to prevent flicker before it attaches, put opacity: 0 in the consuming side’s CSS.
options.from · mid · to: Video scale start · after rising · end, default .7 · .94 · 1.1

note: With reduced motion, the curtain is turned off and only text shows. Video autoplay and loop are left to the implementer <video autoplay muted loop playsinline> It’s your share
